_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- TELESCOPES mode: the 6.5 m MMT (MMT Observatory, Mt. Hopkins) -- Cassegrain foci f/5, f/9, f/15 and the entrance pupil
_meta.companion: data/telescopes/mmt.md (same content as Markdown). Structure follows elt.json: sources{key: cite, file, url}; mmt: title, telescope (machine-readable primary, secondaries, pupil, foci; refs point to sourced params as 'mmt.<param>'), explorer_preset (the proposed web/tpresets.js entry), params, not_found, conflicts, notes.
_meta.rule: Each value carries src (key into sources), loc and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/telescopes/mmt/. derived = arithmetic done here (shown). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). FIGURE READ-OFF = a value read off a saved figure (the caption or nearby text is checked). INFERRED = a reasoned guess no source states. NOT FOUND marks a gap. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.quote_normalization: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign (to x), division slash, tilde operator, approximately-equal sign, middle dot and plus-minus (to +/-) normalized; the degree sign, ring above, white bullet and superscript-zero degree glyphs removed (TR35 drops the degree sign); whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes against the text with PDF line-end hyphenation removed or closed up, or with all whitespace removed; ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces.
_meta.texts_checked: pdftotext -layout and -raw per page and across consecutive page pairs (PDF p. = page index of the saved PDF); HTML as tag-stripped text (tags to a space, tags removed) and raw source (UTF-8); ADS JSON raw, decoded and decoded with tags removed; .py as is.
_meta.pupil_frame: the mmtwfs PSF model frame (MWP pupil_model: vanes at support_offset + 90k deg from +x); orientation relative to the elevation axis NOT FOUND
_meta.design_vs_asbuilt: TR35 (Version 7, December 1999) holds the as-built prescriptions (Zemax files dated September 1999) and is the document the observatory still links and its wavefront-sensor code cites; W97 is the earlier design (f/5.4, 20' f/15) and differs in the vertex heights.
_meta.check_result: 154 quotes checked against the saved files, 0 failures (2026-11-16); the FIGURE READ-OFFs (TR35 Fig. 1 hole, C13 Fig. 3a vanes) are not text-checkable: the C13 caption is.

explorer_preset.name: MMT 6.5 m
explorer_preset.primaryNote: A spin-cast borosilicate honeycomb paraboloid from the Steward Observatory Mirror Lab, 6.5 m across (6502 mm clear), radius of curvature 16.256 m (f = 8.128 m, f/1.25), with a 0.9 m central hole. Three interchangeable secondaries, each giving its own Cassegrain focus: f/5 (1.7 m), f/9 (1.0 m) and the f/15 adaptive secondary (0.64 m).
explorer_preset.pupilNote: Four 0.12 m vanes from the center, at 45° to the axes (the observatory's own wavefront-sensor model; the vanes' orientation relative to the elevation axis is not published). The central obstruction changes with the secondary: the 1.7 m f/5 mirror, the 1.0 m f/9 mirror, or at f/15 the primary's 0.9 m hole.

foci.name: f/5 Cassegrain, spectroscopic corrector (ADC)
foci.secondary: convex hyperboloid, 1.7 m (Zerodur), 6.18 m above the primary; then the wide-field corrector: three fused-silica lenses and counter-rotating ADC prisms

foci.name: f/9 Cassegrain

foci.fieldNote: 12′ unvignetted (13′ in the observatory's description). The obstruction drawn is the 1.02 m mirror; the f/9 baffle is not published.

foci.name: f/15 adaptive secondary

foci.fieldNote: 5′ at most (6′ unvignetted in the 2003 interface document). The adaptive secondary is the stop: the pupil is 6.37 m, and the obstruction is the primary's 0.9 m hole, which hides the 0.64 m secondary.

f/5 imaging field: 0.5 deg (TR35, MMTI) vs 0.58 deg (F05) vs 35' (M06, Megacam) vs > 30' unvignetted (ICD03).
Bare f/5 back focal distance: 1851 +/- 4 mm (TR35 table) vs 1849.67 mm (TR35 Sec. 2.2 and Fig. 1).
f/9 field: 12' unvignetted (TR35, ICD03) vs 13' (MMTI, W97; ICD03: 0.5" rms over 13').
f/15 field: 5' at most (MMTI) vs 6' unvignetted (ICD03, TR35) vs 20' fixed or chopping (W97 design; ICD03: 0.5" rms over 20').

f/15 focal length: 95.50 m from 0.463 mm/arcsec (TR35, ICD03) vs 95.03 m paraxial from the TR35 prescription (DERIVED, 0.5% shorter); f/15 focal surface radius 849 mm (TR35 table, ICD03) vs 864 mm (TR35 Sec. 2.5).
f/15 secondary: 640 mm (MMTAO, MAR00, C13) vs 642.05 mm (TR35, preliminary); shell 1.9 mm (MMTAO) vs 1.8 mm (MAR00).
f/15 pupil and obstruction: 6.37 m with a 0.9 m obscuration (MIR25) vs 6.5 m with the 640 mm secondary (C13 model).

Spider width: 0.12 m (MWC) vs ~0.1 m (MIR25) vs 50 mm (PIS01S, telescope uncertain); orientation: 45 deg (MWC) vs 0/90 deg (C13 Fig. 3a model), both in frames with no stated relation to the elevation axis.
Central hole: 0.898 m (MIR25, PIS01H) vs ~0.92 m (TR35 Fig. 1 FIGURE READ-OFF, a layout drawing).
Corrector location: "just behind the primary mirror vertex" (M15; TR35 Fig. 1: first surface 29.4 mm behind the vertex) vs "near the focal plane" (MMTT, public page).
notes: All foci are Cassegrain foci on the one instrument rotator behind the primary (ICD03); the MMT has no Nasmyth or prime focus. The foci differ only by the secondary (and, at f/5, the corrector): 2 reflections each.

The entrance pupil is the primary (6.502 m) at f/5 and f/9; at f/15 the undersized adaptive secondary is the stop, so the pupil shrinks to 6.37 m and the primary's 0.9 m hole becomes the obstruction (the 0.64 m shell lies in the hole's shadow).

The spider is taken to be the same for all three secondaries (INFERRED: W97 says the f/15 hub stays attached for all Cassegrain modes, and MWC uses one telescope-level spider for the f/5 and f/9 wavefront sensors).

Status (2026): the f/5 secondary is on the telescope ~30% of the time (MMTC); Binospec and MMIRS are the available f/5 instruments; Hectospec and Hectochelle were decommissioned in summer 2026 (MMTOH); Blue Channel and SPOL are available at f/9 (the f/9 was expected to be phased out in 2003, ICD03); the f/15 with MAPS is shared risk (MMTAO, MMTI).
TR35 Fig. 1 and the ICD03 flange distances agree: 1466.85 mm + 12.25 in = 1778.0 mm (f/9) and + 32.25 in = 2286.0 mm (f/15).
Pupil demagnification (TR35): f/5 4.13, f/9 6.69, f/15 9.93; the f/15 beam would be 655 mm at the secondary, more than the 642 mm mirror: hence the stop.
